headline: HuyenBao v11.46 — progressive disclosure, sửa i18n leak, birth year input, tutorial, dedup
summary: UX CLEANUP. (1) PROGRESSIVE DISCLOSURE: PinZone now hides advanced stats (net worth, income, job, degrees, fame, followers) until the player actually has them — new players see only Cash + Health + Spirit + Age + Level. (2) DEDUP: removed Cash/NetWorth/Income from the Header (was duplicate of PinZone). Asset chart legend hides empty segments (no more '—' rows). (3) TUTORIAL: new-player hint card with pulsing border appears when money < $500 + no income + no gigs done yet, directing them to 'Quick gigs'. (4) HOW TO PLAY MOVED TO TOP: the guide was buried at the bottom; now shows at the top of HomeTab, open by default for players under 25. (5) BIRTH YEAR INPUT: replaced the 100+ item dropdown with a number input (min/max validated). (6) I18N FIX: 'v11.birthDay' key was missing → leaked as literal text in character creation; now defined in EN/VI/ZH.
